name: plain web app worker-placeable
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:alpine
    networks: [portcullis-proxy]

name: mounts core volume hub_data
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - hub_data:/data
volumes:
  hub_data:

name: has TCP router
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    labels:
      traefik.tcp.routers.myrouter.rule: "HostSNI(`*`)"

name: has UDP router
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    labels:
      traefik.udp.routers.myrouter.entrypoints: "dns"

name: has person_secret option
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest

name: has AI companions
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
  companion:
    image: mcp-server:latest

reasons: has AI companions (mcp-gate reaches them on the primary)

name: is a VPN provider
compose:
services:
  gateway:
    image: tailscale:latest

name: uses host-gateway
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    extra_hosts:
      - "auth.example.com:host-gateway"

name: binds outside folder roots (absolute)
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - /data/external:/mnt

reasons: binds /data/external outside the server's folder roots

name: binds outside folder roots (relative)
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - ./data:/mnt

reasons: binds ./data outside the server's folder roots

name: marked placement primary_only
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest

name: multiple reasons
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - hub_data:/data
    extra_hosts:
      - "host:host-gateway"
volumes:
  hub_data:

name: bind under folder roots is ok
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - /srv/data:/mnt

name: bind under templates is ok
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - ./templates/myapp/config.yml:/config.yml:ro

name: long syntax bind outside roots
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /data/external
        target: /mnt

reasons: binds /data/external outside the server's folder roots

name: variable in bind
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - "${DATA_DIR}:/mnt"

reasons: binds /external/data outside the server's folder roots

name: ai unsupported is worker-placeable
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest

name: extra_hosts dict format with host-gateway
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    extra_hosts:
      host.example.com: host-gateway

name: core volume by long syntax
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: postgres_data
        target: /data
volumes:
  postgres_data:

name: non-HTTP backend scheme h2c
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    labels:
      traefik.http.services.myapp.loadbalancer.server.scheme: h2c

name: non-HTTP backend scheme https
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    labels:
      traefik.http.services.backend.loadbalancer.server.scheme: https

name: mounts link_doc volume
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    volumes:
      - link_doc:/data
volumes:
  link_doc:

name: references portcullis-link network
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
networks:
  portcullis-link:
    external: true

reasons: references portcullis-link (reserved for the link networks)

name: references PORTCULLIS_LINK_ variable
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    environment:
      LINK_ADDR: ${PORTCULLIS_LINK_ADDR}

reasons: references reserved core variable PORTCULLIS_LINK_* (not a template variable)

name: references PORTCULLIS_ROLE variable
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
    environment:
      ROLE: ${PORTCULLIS_ROLE}

reasons: references reserved core variable PORTCULLIS_ROLE (not a template variable)

name: ai.chat makes primary-only
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest

reasons: is an AI page (model-provider secrets stay on the primary)

name: ai.unsupported does NOT make primary-only
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: test:latest
